thread:
ana: starting rollout v3.1.0 in change window (USW). Canary 8% now. quick note: release notes got out without the dedicated-pool caveat.
mike: saw deploybot flag about a config mismatch for quant profiles in Dedicated pools. what's the signal?
deploybot: ALERT: dedicated-pool-A observed embedding-sim drift +6.4% and throughput -9% vs baseline (4m). Auto-rollback criteria: drift >=8% OR throughput drop >=20% OR errors >=0.5% sustained 5m. Current: drift 6.4%, throughput -9%, errors 0.03%.
ops-oncall: Not hitting auto thresholds but given Dedicated customers in region i'd prefer to act proactively. Two options: pin and watch, or do a targeted rollback for dedicated-pool-A and keep hosted/dedicated-B on v3.1.0. Thoughts?
ana: prefer targeted rollback to avoid global churn. We can pin canary globally at 8% while we revert the dedicated pool only. That keeps hosted customers on the new version but restores reserved customers.
mike: agree. I'll run the revert for the dedicated pool and also push a tiny release-note patch calling out "dedicated pools: quant profile mismatch may temporarily affect embeddings and throughput".
legal_sam: quick heads up on comm wording: avoid saying "bug" or "data". Use "performance variance" and "we reverted to a previous configuration while we investigate".
deploybot: ACTION: canary hold applied by ana. Traffic frozen at 8%.
mike: executing targeted rollback `/deploy rollback --to 3.0.9 --region=us-west --scope=dedicated-pool-A --graceful=true` now.
deploybot: ROLLBACK STARTED by mike. Estimated 3-5m to complete targeted pool revert.
cs_leah: prepping customer-safe note for Reserved customers: "We reverted a configuration in your dedicated pool to restore expected throughput; no data impact is expected." Will route through legal for signoff.
(4m)
deploybot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE. dedicated-pool-A reverted to 3.0.9. Canary global slice remains at 8% on v3.1.0.
ops-oncall: verifying metrics for pool-A: embedding-sim drift back to +0.5% vs baseline, throughput restored. Good. Ops will keep the dedicated fallback pinned until we validate a fix.
mike: PR opened for release-note patch and ops playbook update: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/pull/421. Please review.
legal_sam: reviewed comms language and approved.
nana: typo fixed. (note: corrected)
cs_leah: sent proactive customer email to reserved customers in pool-A. No inbound tickets yet.
nana: filing INC-3001 and assigning postmortem to mike for quant-profile reconciliation. Also adding follow-up action: add matrix test that runs quant-profile compatibility in dedicated hardware sims before deploy.
ops-oncall: closing the canary hold now — keep monitoring during ramp windows. We'll only resume pool-A upgrade after a validated fix and a dedicated canary run.
mike: thanks team. TL;DR: targeted dedicated-pool rollback executed to protect reserved customers while minimizing global impact. Postmortem & fix in flight.
